definition: Tractable is a technology company specializing in the development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assess damage to property and vehicles.
details: The AI allows users to appraise damage digitally.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is Tractable (company).
